correctness.rationale: Subtracting F_a(x)=F_a(z) for distinct x,z gives unique ordered collision pair for each nonzero Delta=x-z, hence q^2-1 pairs. Frobenius elimination yields a quartic P_y of leading coefficient a^{q+2}, so fibers <=4, and four roots sum zero. For ordered collision triples the unit-circle parameters alpha=a(x+y),beta=a(x+z),gamma=a(y+z) lie in norm-one U, are distinct, and satisfy alpha beta gamma=a^{1-q}; the inverse formulas reconstruct triples. Inclusion-exclusion yields (q+1)^2-3(q+1)+2h=6N3+24N4; precisely 3(q+1-2h) opposite-pair triples fail to extend to a fourth. Solving first two factorial moments and total sources/targets gives all five displayed N0..N4 expressions. For q=2 mod3, cube character of coefficient determines h=3 for 1/3 coefficients or 0 for 2/3; else h=1. Independent full coefficient-and-fiber enumeration verified q=3 (8 coefficients), q=5 (24), q=7 (48), q=11 (120) including both cube classes; proof covers every odd prime power, not only tests. a=0 and characteristic two excluded.
